{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load and clean data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')
trial_df.columns = ['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'site', 'arm', 'severity', 'age', 'sex', 'assay_batch', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']

# Check response rate by sex
response_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print(f'Response rate by sex:\n{response_by_sex}')

# Check treatment arm balance by sex
balance_by_sex = trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'arm']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(f'Balance of treatment arms by sex:\n{balance_by_sex}')

# Check site distribution by sex
site_by_sex = trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'site']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(f'Site distribution by sex:\n{site_by_sex}')

# Check age distribution by sex
age_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['age'].mean()
print(f'Average age by sex:\n{age_by_sex}')

# Check baseline biomarker by sex
biomarker_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f'Average baseline biomarker by sex:\n{biomarker_by_sex}')"}
